_meta.description: Free-tier monster recipes for the standalone Monstrous Feast module.

recipes.name: Campfire Monster Roast
recipes.description: Spit-roast rough monster cuts over a campfire. Basic but communal.

output.name: Campfire Monster Roast
output.description: Rough-cut monster meat, charred over open flame. Party meal: all party members gain temporary hit points.

ambitiousOutput.name: Well-Turned Monster Roast
ambitiousOutput.description: Properly seasoned and turned. Party meal: all party members gain more temporary hit points.

recipes.successNarrative: The meat crackles and spits. Strange, but the smell draws the whole camp.
recipes.failNarrative: The meat fights the fire. Charred outside, raw inside. The cuts are ruined.

recipes.name: Bear Roast
recipes.description: Slow-roast bear haunch with rations. A warming, powerful meal.

output.name: Bear Roast
output.description: Thick slabs of slow-roasted bear. Party meal: temporary hit points and a surge of strength.

ambitiousOutput.name: Herb-Crusted Bear Roast
ambitiousOutput.description: Expertly crusted. Party meal: greater temporary hit points and a surge of strength.

recipes.successNarrative: The haunch roasts slowly, fat rendering into the coals. The camp fills with a primal, savoury warmth.
recipes.failNarrative: Overcooked and dry. The bear deserved better. Ingredients lost.

recipes.name: Owlbear Stew
recipes.description: A thick stew from owlbear flank simmered down with trail rations.

output.name: Owlbear Stew
output.description: A rich, dark stew with a faintly gamey warmth. Party meal: darkvision until your next long rest.

ambitiousOutput.name: Seasoned Owlbear Stew
ambitiousOutput.description: Deeply flavoured, slow-simmered perfection. Party meal: darkvision and sharper senses in dim light.

recipes.successNarrative: The stew darkens as it simmers. There is something primal in the smell. Everyone reaches for a bowl.
recipes.failNarrative: The owlbear meat toughens and the stew goes bitter. A waste of rare ingredients.

recipes.name: Camp Bread
recipes.description: Flatbread baked on a hot stone. The backbone of any real camp meal.

output.name: Camp Bread
output.description: A dense, warm loaf split around the fire. Party meal: a little temporary hit points to start the day.

ambitiousOutput.name: Golden Camp Loaf
ambitiousOutput.description: Risen high with a crackling crust. Party meal: more temporary hit points to start the day.

recipes.successNarrative: The dough puffs and browns on the stone. Warm bread in the wilds lifts everyone.
recipes.failNarrative: Scorched on one side, raw in the middle. The loaf is a loss.

recipes.name: Crispy Beast Tempura
recipes.description: Monster cuts battered in flour and flash-fried in hot oil. Light, crisp, deceptively filling.

output.name: Crispy Beast Tempura
output.description: Shatteringly crisp batter over tender meat. Party meal: a hearty surge of temporary hit points.

ambitiousOutput.name: Golden Beast Tempura
ambitiousOutput.description: Fried to a flawless gold. Party meal: a greater surge of temporary hit points.

recipes.successNarrative: The oil sings and the batter blooms. Hot, crisp, and gone in moments.
recipes.failNarrative: The oil catches too hot. Burnt batter, greasy meat, a smoking ruin.

recipes.name: Forest Omelet
recipes.description: Eggs folded around diced monster meat. Quick, hot, and sharpens the senses for the road.

output.name: Forest Omelet
output.description: Soft folds of egg around savoury meat. Party meal: temporary hit points.

ambitiousOutput.name: Fluffy Forest Omelet
ambitiousOutput.description: Light, airy, and perfectly folded. Party meal: temporary hit points and sharper senses in dim light.

recipes.successNarrative: The pan hisses and the eggs set golden. A quick, bright meal before the road.
recipes.failNarrative: The eggs catch and tear. A rubbery mess not worth serving.
